run_evaluate_dst_cli: run the evaluate_dst CLI to compare true and predicted DST model JSON outputs and save an evaluation report
evaluate_from_json: evaluate DST model predictions by comparing true and predicted dialogue data in nested JSON format
evaluate_from_flat_list: evaluate DST model predictions from flattened turn-level lists and return joint accuracy and F1 metrics
evaluate_frame: evaluate a single DST frame by comparing dialog act, slot values, request slots, objects, and disambiguation candidates
evaluate_turn: evaluate a single dialogue turn by iterating over its frames and aggregating per-frame evaluation counts
